target.title: feat(android): manage skills from settings
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Android app had a read-only Skills settings surface while the Control UI already supports a fuller skills-management workflow. Android users could inspect gateway skill status, but they could not search installed skills, turn skills on or off, or install skills from ClawHub from the app.

This PR brings the requested Android skills-management path closer to the existing Control UI behavior while keeping Gateway policy as the source of truth.

## Summary

- Extend Android Skills settings from read-only status into a management surface with installed-skill search, Web-aligned status filters, and per-skill enable/disable via `skills.update`.
- Add ClawHub registry search and install from Android via `skills.search` / `skills.install`.
- Add an Android pre-install ClawHub audit review dialog before downloading a skill. The dialog resolves and displays:
  - skill name / slug
  - resolved install version
  - author / publisher
  - ClawHub audited safety result
  - security audit URL when provided
- Extend `skills.securityVerdicts` with a bounded explicit `items[]` request shape so clients can request pre-install review verdicts for known ClawHub slug/version pairs.
- Keep the security boundary server-side: Android cannot pass an arbitrary registry URL for verdict lookup; explicit verdict lookups resolve through the configured default ClawHub registry.
- Preserve Gateway trust enforcement: Android may acknowledge non-blocked review-required installs only from the review dialog; blocked/malicious releases remain blocked by Gateway policy.
- Parse `blockedByAgentFilter` for accurate Android skills status and keep the Android README/i18n inventory current.

## Web UI Reference Checked

Reviewed the existing Control UI skills implementation in:

- `ui/src/pages/skills/view.ts`
- `ui/src/pages/skills/skills-page.ts`
- `ui/src/lib/skills/index.ts`

Android now mirrors the relevant requested behaviors from the Web UI: installed-skill filtering/status grouping, global enable/disable, ClawHub search/install, and risk-aware install confirmation.

## Gateway/API Notes

- `skills.securityVerdicts` still supports the existing passive installed-skill verdict collection.
- New explicit mode accepts at most 25 `{ slug, version, ownerHandle? }` items.
- Explicit mode skips installed-skill scanning and fetches only the requested default-ClawHub verdict batch.
- Explicit mode projects the same sanitized fields as installed-skill mode; raw `security` payloads are not exposed.

- CI run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28942919382

Local/static preflight used before the final evidence refresh:

- `git diff --check upstream/main...origin/android-skills-management`

Real Android media proof captured from the `snowzlmbot` fork Actions, isolated to PR #101864:

- Proof run: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/28953994860

  - `.github/workflows/android-clawhub-skills-real-media-proof.yml`
  - `scripts/proof/android-clawhub-skills-real-media-capture.sh`
  - `scripts/proof/pr101864-expected-head.txt`
- Artifact: `android-clawhub-skills-real-media-proof-v1` (`8173488815`, 42,960,463 bytes)

Real media artifact contents verified:

- `06-real-clawhub-search-results.png` — 146,297 bytes, sha256 `59aab10a6041e0c8d7f5116079b99702c9cff247dc4f7202079c9540ec4d23d4`
- `07-real-clawhub-review-dialog.png` — 189,436 bytes, sha256 `82a840814b20eab23f2fa8c22fa373c419f44cae31b35996756b3b65dbfbf6c1`
- `clawhub-results.mp4` — 147,032 bytes, sha256 `1d0e4107f2334236e53c1d02477fd3061ae79cbb7eaf836ba55851ab1891c58a`
- `clawhub-review-dialog.mp4` — 87,735 bytes, sha256 `e2fec8d667de699010b5c9462dacefd19a4097ee236c200d5ed2d36a84ebaaa2`

The proof run uses a GitHub-hosted `ubuntu-24.04` runner and an Android API 35 emulator. It launches the Android app normally, with screenshot mode disabled, and captures the production navigation path:

- Android launcher → Settings → Skills → ClawHub search → ClawHub install review dialog.

RPC/API evidence included in the same artifact:

- `gateway-skills-search.json` shows `skills.search` returning `Proof Clean Skill` / `proof-clean-skill`.
- `gateway-skills-detail.json` shows the ClawHub skill detail used for review.
- `gateway-skills-verdict.json` shows the `clean` security verdict plus `securityAuditUrl`.
- `clawhub-fixture.jsonl` logs the real Gateway HTTP requests made during the run:
  - `/api/v1/search`
  - `/api/v1/skills/proof-clean-skill`
  - `/api/v1/skills/-/security-verdicts`

## Risk Notes

- ClawHub install remains routed through Gateway `skills.install` policy; Android does not bypass trust checks.
- Explicit verdict lookup is bounded and registry selection remains server-controlled to avoid turning Android into an arbitrary external fetch surface.
- Android can request a review verdict for known ClawHub slug/version pairs, but it cannot select an arbitrary registry URL for that lookup.
- The Android toggle changes the global skill enabled state. Agent allowlist/filter state is shown accurately but not edited by this PR.
- The final media proof is a real GitHub Actions Android emulator screenshot/video capture for this PR head, not a hand-authored SVG or local mock screenshot.
